description:
# 🔮 SkyrimNet-OStim Integration 🔥

## Overview

This integration mod creates a powerful bridge between **SkyrimNet** AI framework and **OStim** adult framework for Skyrim, enabling natural language control over intimate encounters. Simply chat with NPCs and the AI will intelligently interpret your dialogue to initiate, modify, or end intimate scenes! 🗣️💬

> ⚠️ **When you see Skyrim message boxes NEVER use mouse to answer them, it will make sometimes your camera to fly away, it is known issue without known solution. Use keyboard hotkeys to select confirmation option.**

> 📝 **NOTE**: This integration does NOT alter the main SkyrimNet prompt to make NPCs more sexually forward or explicit. NPCs will maintain their established personalities and relationship boundaries. The mod simply adds capabilities for the AI to understand and interact with OStim functionality when appropriate within character.

## ✨ Features

- **📚 Available Actions**
- **⚙️ Configuration Settings**
- **🎭 Intents, Roles, Scenes & Threads**
- **⏳ Thread Phases**
- **👀 Spectators System**
- **🧠 AI Encounter Evaluations**
- **📝 Scene Descriptions**
- **💬 Confirmation Messages**
- **💦 OCum Integration** - Enhances AI awareness with fluid overlays and generates more immersive climax narratives.

changelog:
!!!ATTENTION!!!
It requires new OStim Navigator version 2.3.0(https://github.com/tetherball88/OStimNavigator/releases/tag/v2.3.0)

### Added

- **Faster, more reliable AI scene setup & progression (SkyrimNet Decisions support)** — OStimNet now uses SkyrimNet's **Decisions** system to evaluate and set up scenes step-by-step instead of relying solely on long, complex AI text responses:
  - Makes scene evaluations significantly faster, more consistent, and far less prone to AI formatting errors—especially with smaller or faster AI models.
  - Covers all scene evaluations: starting new sexual or affectionate scenes, inviting or joining ongoing scenes, automatic scene progression, near-climax pull-out decisions, spontaneous NPC location scans, and scenes started by external mods.
  - Enabled by default under **General → Use Jev Decisions for evaluations**. If no Decisions model is configured in SkyrimNet, OStimNet automatically falls back to the standard Game Master AI without any extra setup needed.

Full changelog is on github.
